title: Lead growth without qualified growth
expected_artifacts: A source-linked funnel diagnosis, rival-explanation review, separate economics findings and a smallest-change repair proposal with protected versions. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Qualification falls from 20% to 10% of leads while qualified-to-paid remains 20%. All-in CAC rises from 125 to 256.25; after-acquisition cohort contribution changes from 600 to -450. The evidence points toward acquisition mix/qualification cost, not automatic proof that offer, price or delivery needs redesign. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail a customer/price/brand rewrite without additional evidence, media-only CAC, unmatched denominators, or calling a proposed reversal an observed causal improvement.
preservation: Preserve all four accepted versions. Propose source/filter/test changes only; new evidence can later implicate another layer, but it must be retained explicitly.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
